description: Regression detection thresholds for Phase 2 CI/CD. If Phase 2 metrics fall below PASS thresholds, manual review required.

detection_rate.interpretation: Phase 2 detection must stay ≥75% (5% below baseline). <70% triggers review.

determinism_score.interpretation: Phase 2 determinism must stay ≥90%. <90% indicates potential instability.

cvss_variance.interpretation: Phase 2 CVSS variance must stay ≤0.25 (baseline + 6%). >0.35 indicates concerning instability.

ai_value_score.interpretation: Phase 2 AI contribution must stay ≥75%. Dynamic analysis should increase this to 0.90+.

tool_complementarity.interpretation: Phase 2 should maintain healthy tool separation. Overlap <45% acceptable; >45% flags redundancy.

performance.interpretation: Phase 2 can tolerate 2x slowdown (dynamic analysis overhead). >20s per fixture triggers investigation.

expected_improvements: Detection rate: 100% → 95%+ (dynamic analysis adds coverage for runtime vulnerabilities)
AI value score: 83% → 90%+ (runtime signals provide new correlation opportunities)
Determinism: 98% → 95%+ (dynamic traces may introduce minor variance)
red_flags_requiring_review: Any step regresses from PASS to WARN/FAIL

ci_cd_integration_notes.automated_checks: Compare Phase 2 metrics against thresholds. Auto-fail on critical regressions.
ci_cd_integration_notes.manual_review: WARN threshold requires human review before merge.
ci_cd_integration_notes.reporting: Generate regression delta report highlighting changes vs Phase 1 baseline.
ci_cd_integration_notes.gates: Phase 2 release requires PASS verdict on all metrics.
